webSearch.apiKey.label: Staan API Key
webSearch.apiKey.help: Staan Search API key (fallback: STAAN_API_KEY env var).

webSearch.baseUrl.label: Staan Search Base URL
webSearch.baseUrl.help: Optional Staan API base URL override. OpenClaw appends /search/web when the URL does not already end there.

webSearch.market.label: Staan Default Market
webSearch.market.help: Default market for searches, e.g. en-gb, fr-fr, de-de. Callers can override per query.
